notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Today's update closes a potential bug-exploit for finishing levels without finishing them.

In addition, holding shift while double-clicking on the shortcut icon will now display a resolution dialog where you can configure things like vsync, should you want to.

notes.title: Update June 10th
notes.notes:
Hello!  Thanks all for the warm reception, we've gathered up a few minor issues and pushed an update just a few minutes ago.

- You can pick your preferred language via the game's properties
    (right-click on TransPlan in your library, properties, language tab)
- Fixed some japanese strings overflowing button artwork
- Added spanish and german
- Adjusted button sizing to behave better for some locales
